verdict.rationale: Mercury's Command assistant already answers financial questions 'grounded in your account data' (mercury-books-supp-command), satisfying the query semantics of 'can we afford X', but this happens inside Mercury's own UI, not via an external API that an arbitrary agent could call. The dedicated accounting API and MCP layer needed for third-party agents to pull live ledger data are explicitly future ('Soon...') per mercury-books-docs-1/10/11, and probes confirm no public OpenAPI/llms.txt exists yet (mercury-books-probe-1, mercury-books-probe-2). Missing for 10: a live, documented API/MCP endpoint that external agents can call today, and evidence of an agent (not just Command's built-in chat) answering affordability questions grounded in that API.
